snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system long seen as strong in the region, now in crisis as falling diamond revenues hit public finances. A public health emergency over medicine shortages has been in place since August 2025.

priorities.title: Medicine availability
priorities.text: The assistant minister reported to parliament on medicines availability in July 2026.

priorities.title: Local drug manufacturing
priorities.text: Botswana is targeting domestic drug manufacturing as part of recovery from the health emergency.
